name: China Publishing & Media Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: China Publishing & Media Holdings Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in producing and distributing a wide array of media content across China. Its portfolio encompasses traditional books, audio-visual materials, and various forms of electronic and online publications. Beyond content creation, the company's activities extend to both print and digital publishing workflows, offering printing and duplication services, and facilitating copyright transactions. Additionally, it provides diverse information-related services. This enterprise was founded in 2011 and operates from its headquarters in Beijing, China.
